findings.title: py.typed is absent, and the register's stated basis for exempting it is not in the rule text
findings.claim: The strict-typing platinum rule requires the package to ship a py.typed marker file and states there are no exceptions, but the package ships 0 of them and the register marks the row done on an exemption the rule text does not contain.
findings.mechanism: The rule text (fetched /tmp/harules/strict-typing.md) says "you need to add a `py.typed` file to your library" and its Exceptions section says "There are no exceptions to this rule"; the register's comment ("the Platinum rule's marker-file half does not apply to a custom integration") is invented and appears in neither the rule nor its warning box.

evidence.unit: count of py.typed files in the package (qs_py_typed_files)
evidence.machine: darwin 25.6.0 arm64, 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, Python 3.11.5, mypy 2.3.1
evidence.contention_note: shared 8-core box under round-7 fan-out; every number here is a count or a parse of deterministic output, so none is contention-sensitive

findings.instrumented_symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer: the package's py.typed marker file

perturbation.change: write an empty py.typed into the package in a scratch copy (--perturb py-typed)

findings.metric_definition: count of py.typed files anywhere under the package directory (qs_py_typed_files)
findings.phenomenon_property: A package that declares strict-typing adherence ships a py.typed marker file at its root, and the register may not record the row done on a carve-out the rule text lacks.
reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=... python3 tools/audit/round7/D10/qs_rules_r7.py --perturb py-typed  ->  before 0, after 1
read /tmp/harules/strict-typing.md: the Rule section requires the file; the Exceptions section says there are none
findings.proposed_fix_scope: ship custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/py.typed (empty is sufficient), and replace the register row's unsupported exemption with the executed number or a basis the rule text carries.

findings.title: The custom typed config entry is not 'used throughout': 88 of 100 entry parameters are bare ConfigEntry
findings.claim: The strict-typing rule's warning requires the custom typed MyIntegrationConfigEntry 'used throughout' when the integration implements runtime-data, but only 10 of 100 entry parameters use the alias HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry and 88 use bare, unparameterised ConfigEntry.
findings.mechanism: entry.runtime_data is assigned in async_setup_entry (runtime-data is implemented) and the alias HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry exists, but every platform module and config_flow.py annotate their entry parameter as plain ConfigEntry, so runtime_data reads as Any at each of the 88 sites. mypy --strict flags exactly this as [type-arg] 'Missing type arguments for generic type'.

evidence.unit: count of entry parameters annotated bare ConfigEntry (qs_entry_param_bare)
evidence.machine: darwin 25.6.0 arm64, 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, Python 3.11.5, mypy 2.3.1
evidence.contention_note: shared 8-core box under round-7 fan-out; every number here is a count or a parse of deterministic output, so none is contention-sensitive

findings.instrumented_symbol: custom_components.heatpump_optimizer: every function parameter named 'entry' and its annotation (bare ConfigEntry vs the HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry alias)

perturbation.change: rewrite every bare 'entry: ConfigEntry' parameter with the custom HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry alias, all three source spellings, in a scratch copy (--perturb entry-alias)

findings.metric_definition: count of parameters named 'entry' annotated bare ConfigEntry across the package (qs_entry_param_bare)
findings.phenomenon_property: With runtime-data implemented, every entry parameter is typed with the integration's custom typed config entry, so entry.runtime_data carries the coordinator type at every site.

null_control.note: the [type-arg] slice falls 95 -> 0 without --strict, confirming the diagnostic is strictly a strict-mode one and not noise

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=... python3 tools/audit/round7/D10/qs_rules_r7.py --perturb entry-alias  ->  bare 88 -> 0, custom 10 -> 98
PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub MYPYPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/round7/D10/mypy_strict.py --perturb entry-alias  ->  mypy_type_arg 95 -> 7
findings.proposed_fix_scope: annotate every 'entry' parameter with the existing HeatPumpOptimizerConfigEntry alias across the six platform modules and config_flow.py (88 sites); re-run mypy_strict.py and expect mypy_type_arg to fall to single digits.
